LESSON: CAPACITY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.3: Capacity
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Capacity, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How can we measure capacity? 2. How is capacity applicable in real life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  Work out the relationship between cm3 , milliliters and liters throughmeasuring practically in purposive groups/pairs or as individuals. Learners with poor motor coordination or missing limbs could use adapted writing materials or appropriate adapted digital devices to perform the task. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Capacity together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
